d:
Shri hanumanashtak aadity garhvi ke bhavyukt svar men. sankatmochan hanumanashtak ki sanrachna gosvami tulsidas ne ki thi. mana jata hai ki sankatmochan hanumanashtak ka path karne se vyakti apni har badha aur pira se mukt ho jata hai aur uske sabhi sankat dur ho jate hain.
Watch the video song of "Ati Laghu Roop Kareyu Hanumana" now!
Bharat shri ram ko ayodhya ka raja banane ki than lete hain aur unhen manane ke lie apni mataon, rishi jan evan mantriyon ke sath van ki or prasthan karte hain. yah sundar bhakti git bharat ka shri ram prati sneh aur shraddha ki anubhuti karata hai.
